ngaap.guidance: The Company has largely achieved its previous 5-year guidance over the past 3-year period. Consequently, the Company is replacing its previous long-term guidance with new 5-year guidance. The Company expects mid-single digit revenue growth CAGR, 350+ bps of adjusted operating margin expansion, and double digit EPS growth CAGR while delivering greater than 90% average cash conversion over the 5-year period through the end of 2029. Wabtec’s 2025 financial guidance expects sales to be in a range of $10.725 billion to $11.025 billion and adjusted earnings per diluted share to be in a range of $8.35 to $8.75. For full year 2025, Wabtec expects strong cash flow generation with operating cash flow conversion of greater than 90 percent.
ngaap.notes: Wabtec 'adjusted' results exclude restructuring (Integration 2.0 and Portfolio Optimization) costs and non-cash intangible amortization expense, each tax-effected. EBITDA = income from operations + other income (expense) + D&A; Adjusted EBITDA adds the restructuring costs shown in the EBITDA table (excludes restructuring already within D&A, e.g. accelerated depreciation/asset write-downs, so it differs from the adjusted-table restructuring add-back). Cash conversion table D&A (incl. deferred debt cost amortization): 503; operating cash flow conversion 1834/(1067+503).

extra.notes: Employees: approximately 29,500 excluding contingent workers (10-K). seg_dda / seg_capex from 10-K 2024 segment note (ASU 2023-07 format with segment cost of sales, SG&A, engineering, amortization). Depreciation $196m (10-K). extra.amortization = IS Amortization expense (303); non-cash amortization add-back 288. Portfolio Optimization: ~$28m charges in 2024 (Freight ~$18m, Transit ~$10m; ~$56m to date; ~$70m total expected), primarily asset write-downs; proceeds from dispositions of businesses $19m (CF) and a ~$4m net gain recorded below operating income and excluded from adjusted results. Integration 2.0 charges $28m in 2024 ($146m to date; target ~$100m run-rate synergies by end of 2026). Integration 3.0 announced Feb 2025. Subsequent event: 14-Jan-2025 definitive agreement to acquire Evident's Inspection Technologies division for $1.78bn (Freight Digital Intelligence). ARINC/Collins rail-signalling acquisition is not part of FY2024 (not in 10-K 2024).
